lineage: Robustness check on D2 pathway spatial organization (results/p2_niches.json pw_I, summary p2_niches_summary.json). Designed after D2 outcomes were known (D2: Moran's I vs 50 label shuffles; 100% of sections p<0.05 for top pathways including Mitotic Spindle, G2-M, Myc). The D2 results stay on record unchanged.
concern: D2's null shuffles spot positions, which destroys all spatial structure, so ANY smooth, tissue-structured quantity (including a random gene set) is expected to score significant. The D2 test therefore cannot tell hallmark pathways from arbitrary gene sets.
question: Do hallmark pathway scores show more spatial autocorrelation than size- and expression-matched random gene sets?
data: Lane B features_cache counts, 29 HER2+ sections as in p2_niches.py, same universe, same pathway_scores (z-score within section, mean over genes), same Gaussian weights (1.5 x pitch), same Moran's I.
null: Per section and per pathway: 200 random gene sets of identical size, each gene replaced by a random gene from the same quintile of section mean log-expression (gene-level matching). Score and Moran's I computed identically. seed 20261008. Per-section empirical p=(1+#null>=obs)/201; excess = observed I - null median.
endpoints: Per pathway: fraction of sections with p<0.05, and median excess with 95% section-bootstrap CI (10000).
gate: A pathway SURVIVES if fraction of sections with p<0.05 >= 0.60 AND median excess > 0. The D2 claim 'pathway architecture is spatially organized beyond chance' SURVIVES only if all three top D2 pathways (Myc Targets V1, Mitotic Spindle, G2-M Checkpoint) survive AND the D2 negative control (Pancreas Beta Cells) does NOT survive. If Pancreas Beta Cells also survives, the metric is non-specific and D2's claim is reported as not supported by this check. Result and counts of surviving pathways out of all reported are locked either way.
limits_declared: Same 29 HER2+ sections; random gene sets matched on expression level only (not on cell-type specificity or co-expression), so a pathway can pass or fail for reasons of coherence rather than biology; Moran's I with a fixed length scale; descriptive, no independent cohort.
not_done: No outcome computed when this file was written.
